name: Nancy Zabaneh
reason: Health/therapy rule, applied strictly: her own site (nancyzabaneh.com, Dubai base published on /about/) presents her as a trauma-informed facilitator and Compassionate Inquiry psychotherapy coordinator offering counselling and the Beyond Addiction programme, her retreats page frames them around addiction work, somatic healing and the nervous system, and her Kundalini page promises effects on the nervous system and glands, so no offering passes and the work reads as mainly therapeutic. Otherwise strong (Kundalini teacher trainer since 2017, YouTube @nancyzabaneh-darshan4114 with about ten clean meditation videos, contact form at /get-in-touch/, no published email): worth an owner's second look.
